evals.name: new-code-plan
evals.prompt: Plan adding a read-only mode to the CLI in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Reads CLAUDE.md and the code, asks one question Q1 via AskUserQuestion with the recommendation first, and after the first answer creates docs/plans/<slug>/README.md with Planning: draft.
expectations: Asks exactly one question per message
The recommended option is first and marked (Recommended) with a reason
The question has id Q1
README.md is created in <repo root>/docs/plans/<slug>/ with Planning: draft after the first answer
Does not start implementation

evals.name: non-code-plan
evals.prompt: Lay out a plan for my move to Kraków in March.
evals.expected_output: A non-code plan: no code reading, stages with executor user, criteria are checkable facts, no .brief.md files for user stages.
expectations: Does not treat the task as software engineering (no tests as criteria)
Stages have executor user or mixed
No NN-*.brief.md for user stages
Acceptance criteria are observable facts
Outside a repo asks about location, recommending ./plans/<slug>/
The substantive breakdown is in the Detailed plan section of the stage spec

evals.name: seed-from-backlog
evals.prompt: Make a plan from the parked idea about caching report queries.
evals.expected_output: Finds docs/backlog/cache-for-report-queries.md, moves open questions into the Q<n> queue, writes Source in the README, offers a History entry in the backlog with consent.
expectations: Finds the backlog file by description
Open questions from the backlog become Q<n> questions (the first asked first)
The plan README has a Source field pointing to the backlog file
Does not edit the backlog file without consent

evals.name: resume-draft
evals.prompt: Let's get back to the plan tracker-read-only-mode.
evals.expected_output: Reads the README with Planning: draft, asks the first open question, does not repeat settled ones.
expectations: Asks the first question from the Open questions section
Does not re-ask decisions recorded in the Decisions section
Keeps the Q<n> numbering

evals.name: autonomous
evals.prompt: Plan on your own, no questions, the migration of logging from console.log to pino.
evals.expected_output: Asks no questions, decides by recommendation, records decisions marked autonomous, ends with Planning: complete.
expectations: Does not use AskUserQuestion
Decisions in the README are marked as autonomous
Planning: complete at the end

evals.name: query-status
evals.prompt: Can I start the next stage of the plan yet?
evals.expected_output: Read-only on the README; a yes/no answer per the gate rule, quoting statuses verbatim.
expectations: Does not edit files or run tests/agents
Answers yes only when Planning: complete and the previous stage is done
Quotes the status verbatim from the README
